title: Year-end liability and estimate review
html:

Evaluate a subsequent-disbursement schedule and two judgmental matters.

exhibits.title: Payments after year-end
exhibits.html: Payment A: $22,000 for December services, not accrued. Payment B: $18,000 for January services. Payment C: $31,000 for goods received before year-end, not accrued. All amounts are valid obligations.

exhibits.title: Other matters
exhibits.html: Management sets an unsupported reserve assumption to meet a profit target and refuses necessary legal-counsel inquiry about material litigation.
